findings.message: ClusterRole/default/stageproof-rel-alloy adds rules that the current chart did not have.
Chart default `configReloader.image.registry` changed from `ghcr.io` to `quay.io` and the rendered objects differ.
Chart default `configReloader.image.repository` changed from `jimmidyson/configmap-reload` to `prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader` and the rendered objects differ.
Chart default `configReloader.image.tag` changed from `v0.14.0` to `v0.81.0` and the rendered objects differ.
The pod template of DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy changed at spec.template.spec.containers[name=alloy].image. The pods will restart. A restart is normal for an upgrade.

findings.detail: This is the chart's declared application version. It is not a test that the registry tag exists.
findings.message: appVersion moves from v1.7.4 to v1.7.5. The image that the chart runs may change with it.

findings.detail: The render names a different image, including images on custom resources and images passed as container arguments. Whether that tag exists is a separate check.
findings.message: 2 container images changed. DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy.template.spec.containers[0] alloy container moves from docker.io/grafana/alloy:v1.7.4 to docker.io/grafana/alloy:v1.7.5. DaemonSet/stageproof-check/stageproof-rel-alloy.template.spec.containers[1] config-reloader container moves from ghcr.io/jimmidyson/configmap-reload:v0.14.0 to quay.io/prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader:v0.81.0.

findings.detail: A rehearsal installs the chart into an empty cluster. It does not upgrade data that is already there. An empty-cluster result of 0 restarts does not mean an existing workload stayed up.
findings.message: This chart ships custom resource definitions, and the application it runs is changing. Custom resources that already exist on a real cluster are not in this check.
